cards.title: Clean Core Architecture — Phase 2
cards.subtitle: Product Cost Simulator & Multi-Tier BOM Explosion

description.plain:
Problem (3 bullets) — • Multi-week quotation latency: Cross-functional teams spend 10–18 days manually consolidating multi-level BOMs, outdated purchase info records, and work center rates.
• Volatile commodity & FX risk blindness: Unanticipated price shifts in steel, copper, energy tariffs, and foreign exchange erode projected tender margins by 8–15% post-award.
• Rigid ERP costing structures: Core SAP S/4HANA CK11N/CK40N costing runs are static, require released master data, and cannot run dynamic pre-deal "what-if" simulations without risking productive costing data integrity.

cards.subtitle: Product Cost Simulator & Multi-Tier BOM Explosion

description.plain:
Card 7 — Prerequisites & next step

BTP services + entitlements — SAP BTP Cloud Foundry Runtime (1–2 GB memory), SAP BTP Destination Service (Standard), SAP Authorization & Trust Management (XSUAA), SAP Cloud Connector (for on-prem S/4HANA), SAP AI Core (Phase 2 predictive tender pricing).

S/4HANA config / authorizations — SAP S/4HANA 1909+ (Cloud or On-Premise); Communication Arrangements for BOM (SAP_COM_0002), Routing (SAP_COM_0028), Product Master (SAP_COM_0008), PIR (SAP_COM_0053), Sales Quotation (SAP_COM_0079); Read access to CO-PC and MM valuation views.

cards.title: Clean Core Architecture — Phase 8
cards.subtitle: Product Cost Simulator & Multi-Tier BOM Explosion

description.plain:
Headline metric — 76.4% Faster Quote Cycle Time & ₹12.80 Crore Annual Margin Leakage Averted

Before → after — Before: 14-day average bid turnaround, manual Excel cost rollups, 4.2% unexpected margin drop post-delivery.
After: 2.5-day rapid bid turnaround, 100% automated S/4HANA-grounded should-costing, 0.4% margin deviation.

Supporting metrics (up to 3) — 1. 23.5% Increase in Tender Win Rate: Competitive yet profitable bidding powered by price-to-win predictive boundary analysis.
2. 91.2% Reduction in Costing Effort: Instant multi-tier BOM explosion replaces tedious manual cross-departmental coordination.
3. 100% Hedging Visibility: Upfront exposure detection enables timely raw material advance contracts and currency hedging.
